lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 continuous high-contrast vertical lines and 1 abbreviated posterior segment. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing slightly toward the rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is truncated to the upper quadrant of the torso. A line at the anterior-most position of the torso terminates mid-flank. Multiple isolated white spots are present on the lower ventral flank below the terminal points of the vertical lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A sparse grouping of 3 distinct, high-contrast white circular marks is visible on the lower haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch align on a near-vertical axis, mirroring the orientation of the primary torso stripes.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, exhibiting an initial lateral divergence from the skull base followed by an inward and upward curvature towards the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-toned tipping represents approximately 12% of the total longitudinal length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A ventral fringe of elongated dark hair along the neck and chest; a white chevron mark between the ocular regions; distinct tan/ochre coloration on all four limbs below the carpal and tarsal joints; a single high-contrast white patch on the anterior surface of the front leg carpal joint.
